notes.title: Event for the week of 12/8-12/14
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The Shadow of Kingdoms team is happy to announce our limited Weekly Events for the week of 12/8-12/14.

Charge Ranking Bonus – Thank you very much for supporting Shadow of Kingdoms. Please take these gifts as token of our appreciation. Victory and honor be upon you and your castle!

Diamond Rebate – Spend your precious diamonds to redeem your rebate diamonds back to you. The more diamonds you use, the more diamonds shall return to be used again.

Sweep Gifts – Are you ready to sweep the dungeon? You will get reward if you complete the dungeon “The Wailing Cave” for 10 times. Good Luck!

See you again on the battlefields!

Sincerely,
Shadow of Kingdoms Team

notes.title: Event for the week of 12/1-12/7
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

The Shadow of Kingdoms team is happy to announce our limited Weekly Events for the week of 12/1-12/7.

Lucky Day – Congratulations, today is your lucky day! Receive 120% drops for all dungeons and missions you and your friends complete.

Upgrade Gifts – Is your hero ready to take his/her skills to the next level? Upgrade the quality of your hero to power up and receive special gifts in the process.

Rising Star Gifts – Tired of taking tiny armies to the battlefield? It’s time to raise the star level of your hero to increase unit limit and receive special gifts as well.

Purchase Reward – Thank you very much for supporting Shadow of Kingdoms. The more diamonds you purchase the more you will get. You will receive 20% diamonds more by purchasing more than 100 diamonds. The reward diamonds will be sent via mail within 2 days after ending of the event.

See you again on the battlefields!

Sincerely,
Shadow of Kingdoms Team

notes.title: Server Merge Announcement (Sep 1st)
notes.notes:
We are planning a server merge on Sep 1st. There three servers Jupiter, Ceres and Apollo will be merged! We will start at 3 am EST, September 1st. It will last for about 3 hours. After server merging, we will combine all the players in Jupiter server, but it won't impact your login from other servers. You will be asked to rename your characters if they exist in Jupiter server at the time of the merger.  

Also we will give out a Merger Gift to everyone who will log into Shadow of Kingdoms after merger and before 24 pm EST Sep 7th.  

Enjoy the game! 
Shadow of Kingdoms Team

notes.title: Update 8/18
notes.notes:
Dear Players,

Shadow of Kingdoms team is happy to announce our Limited Weekly Events for the week of 8/18 -8/24. The update will start at 3 AM Aug 18th EST. It will last to 1 hour.

Charge Ranking Bonus – Thank you very much for supporting Shadow of Kingdoms. Please take these gifts as token of our appreciation. Victory and honor be upon you and your castle!

Diamond Rebate – Spend your precious diamonds to redeem your rebate diamonds back to you. The more diamonds you use, the more diamonds shall return to be used again.

Sweep Gifts – Are you ready to sweep the dungeon? You will get reward if you complete the dungeon “The Wailing Cave” 10 times.

Good Luck!

See you again on the battlefields!

Sincerely, 
Shadow of Kingdoms Team
